_comment: Three hand-authored tribes (DESIGN §7), each with its own fear and trust, envoys and raids. `likes` and `hates` are the Rome: Total War web: warming to one cools those who hate it and warms those who like it.

tribes.name: The Chatti
tribes.description: Hill people of the upper Lahn. They respect strength and remember slights.

tribes.name: The Cherusci
tribes.description: Forest people of the Weser. Slow to trust, slow to forgive.

tribes.name: The Sugambri
tribes.description: River people of the lower Rhine. They will sell anything to anyone.

envoys.name: Demand tribute
envoys.description: If they fear you enough they pay. If not, they resent the asking.

envoys.name: Offer trade
envoys.description: Opens exchange at the market. Builds trust.

envoys.name: Propose alliance
envoys.description: Needs high trust and low fear. An allied tribe does not raid.

envoys.name: Ask for hostages
envoys.description: A fearful tribe sends sons of its chiefs; raids stop for a time.

envoys.name: Warn them off
envoys.description: Show your strength. Fear rises, trust dips.

envoys.name: Invite to a festival
envoys.description: Costs grain and denarii. Trust rises.
